description: This file defines the ArchiverManager class, a plugin manager for handling archiver plugins in Drupal, including deprecated status, plugin creation, and extension handling.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Archiver\ArchiverManager
classes.description: A plugin manager class for handling archiver plugins, including deprecated handling, plugin instantiation, and extension support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ArchiverManager with namespace, cache, module handler, and file system dependencies, and triggers deprecation warning.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a specified plugin using its ID and configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a plugin instance matching the provided file path options based on extension matching.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns a space-separated string of supported archive file extensions.
